scope: alliance treasury, separately scoped by world

donations.eligible: current alliance members in the active world

withdrawals.requester: a current alliance member requests a gross resource vector for their own active colony
withdrawals.approver: current leader or a current member with the treasury permission
withdrawals.fee_rounding: floor each resource amount divided by 100
withdrawals.recipient_gets: gross amount minus fee for each resource
withdrawals.expiry_or_cancellation_refund: release the full reserved gross amount

membership_changes: the recipient must still belong to the same alliance at payout; otherwise the reservation is fully released
